name: University Hall, University of Toledo (1931)
refs: refs/r8833546/00 (University of Toledo University Hall, July 2022, Wikimedia Commons)
notes: Collegiate Gothic in buff limestone: three- and four-storey wings with grouped mullioned windows, steep slate-coloured gables, and the central bell tower (LiDAR ~54 m) with corner buttresses and a pinnacled parapet. Wings follow the footprint; the tower sits on the front (Centennial Mall) side.
